data.text: Jack, I support 10 tons each for April. Luke, I appreciate your generosity, but you’re part of this fishing community now—you should earn a living alongside us, not sit out. Your proposal would give us a short-term bonus, but keeping the lake full gives everyone a dependable income. Let’s agree to a combined ceiling of 50 tons while the lake is at capacity, check the reported catches together each month, and adjust if stocks fall. Kate, Emma—are you comfortable committing to 10 tons each?
